lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Thanks for joining. Today we're locking the Q3 roadmap, and the big question is whether we ship the new onboarding flow or the SSO work first.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I'd lean towards onboarding, because activation is our weakest metric right now.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Agreed, our activation rate is still well below target, and I'd like weekly active teams to be our north star for the quarter.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: On the design side we need two weeks of usability testing before engineering starts, and we should run it as an A/B test with a holdout group.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Priya, what's your read on the churn numbers, are we still at around six percent monthly?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Last I checked it was closer to four percent, I'll confirm with Tom and post the exact number in the channel.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I can pull the dashboard by Wednesday if that helps.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: On engineering capacity we have six engineers, but one is on leave for half of the quarter, and the SSO work needs at least three people.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Should we also plan the API rate limiting work? Someone mentioned it last week but I don't remember who owns it.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Nobody owns it yet. We should assign it before the sprint starts.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Decision: onboarding ships first, SSO is scheduled for the second half of the quarter, and we revisit capacity in four weeks.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Elena, can you share the usability test plan with the team by next Monday?

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Sure, I'll send it by next Monday.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: One more thing, the CFO wants a revenue forecast for the onboarding change, but I'd say we can't promise any number until the test finishes.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Priya, do you want to present the roadmap at the all-hands on the twelfth, or should I?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I'll present it. Let me draft the slides and share them with the team before then.
